Title: Battle Hymn
Plot: Dean Hess, who entered the ministry to atone for bombing a German orphanage, decides he’s a failure at preaching. Rejoined to train pilots early in the Korean War, he finds Korean orphans raiding the airbase garbage. With a pretty Korean teacher, he sets up an orphanage for them and others.
Tagline: The true story of Col. Dean Hess, clergyman turned fighter pilot!
